opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants — New Projects and Commissions

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £20,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations. For exhibitions, exhibition catalogues and sculpture commissions that aim to encourage new thinking about sculpture or sculpture history, or contribute to public awareness and appreciation of sculpture.
opportunities.summary: Funds exhibitions, exhibition catalogues and sculpture commissions. Part of the Henry Moore Grants scheme, considered four times per year; the Autumn round is currently open (closes 1 September).

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants — Acquisitions and Collections

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £20,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations. To acquire new sculptural works for collections, or to conserve sculpture in existing collections; also grants for cataloguing and display costs.
opportunities.summary: Funds acquisition of sculptural works for collections, conservation of sculpture in existing collections, and cataloguing and display costs. Part of the Henry Moore Grants scheme; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants — Conferences, Lectures and Publications

amount.raw: The maximum grant awarded in this category is £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations. To publish a new book or journal, or to stage a conference or other event related to sculpture. Exhibition catalogues are only eligible under the New Projects and Commissions category.
opportunities.summary: Funds publication of a new book or journal, or staging a conference or other sculpture-related event. Part of the Henry Moore Grants scheme; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants — Long-Term Research grants

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £20,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations. To support extended research projects requiring funding for more than one year, e.g. a permanent collection catalogue.
opportunities.summary: Funds extended research projects requiring funding for more than one year, such as a permanent collection catalogue. Part of the Henry Moore Grants scheme; Autumn round currently open.

opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants — Research and Travel grants

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £2,500.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals: sculpture historians, academics and conservators who are researching and publishing on sculpture conservation, production, history and/or interpretation. Cannot be used to inform or develop an artist's own work or professional practice.
opportunities.summary: Funds research costs, travel, photography and archival access for individuals researching and publishing on sculpture. Part of the Henry Moore Grants scheme; Autumn round currently open.
